question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Prodigious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Meagre**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **"Prodigious"** means something that is extraordinary, impressive, or immense in size, amount, or degree. (विशालकाय, अद्भुत)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist made a prodigious discovery that changed the course of history.
 
 
• The word **"Meagre"** refers to something that is small in quantity, insufficient, or lacking in richness or fullness. (अल्प, न्यून)
 
 
• **Example:** The family survived on a meagre income, struggling to make ends meet.
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Meagre"** is the most appropriate antonym for **"Prodigious"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Meagre**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Phenomenal** (असाधारण): Something that is remarkable or extraordinary.
 
 
• **Example:** The athlete's performance in the finals was nothing short of phenomenal.
 
 
 
• **Enormous** (विशाल): Very large in size, quantity, or extent.
 
 
• **Example:** The company made an enormous profit last year.
 
 
 
• **Monumental** (स्मरणीय): Something that is great in importance, size, or historical significance.
 
 
• **Example:** The construction of the Great Wall of China was a monumental achievement.

The correct answer is** option 3 i.e., Epigram.**
